## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — see CONTRIBUTING.md (DCO)
- [ ] If this touches `packages/app-spec/src/schema.ts`: I've noted below whether this is a
      breaking change to the Spec contract (requires a major version bump + migration note)
- [ ] New behavior has test coverage (`packages/*/test/`)
- [ ] Docs updated if this changes documented behavior (README / ADR / ROADMAP)
